name: quorum-ivy-source-index
cmd: set -euo pipefail; curl -fsSL --retry 2 'https://api.github.com/repos/aman-goel/ivybench/git/trees/5db7eccb5c3bc2dd14dfb58eddb859b036d699f5?recursive=1' -o "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tree.json"; bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const path=require("path"); const d=process.env.SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; const tree=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(d,"tree.json"),"utf8")); if(tree.truncated)throw Error("truncated tree"); const found=tree.tree.filter(x=>x.type==="blob"&&/naive.?consensus|simple.?election|toy.?consensus.?epr/i.test(x.path)); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(d,"selected.json"),JSON.stringify(found,null,2)); for(const x of found){const response=await fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aman-goel/ivybench/5db7eccb5c3bc2dd14dfb58eddb859b036d699f5/"+x.path);if(!response.ok)throw Error(x.path); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(d,x.path.replaceAll("/","__")),await response.text());}'
